mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth above 1.5% annualized during early to mid-cycle expansion signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate profit momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of early to mid-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP growth and housing starts signal a deepening economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Tight labor market conditions with unemployment below 3.5% signal wage pressures and inflationary risks that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
